---
title: "Figure 4B-C - Antibody correlations with vaccination timing"
output: html_document
---

This notebook shows Spearman correlations between gestational age at maternal
vaccination and selected six-month infant antibody measurements. Run
`01_load_data.Rmd` first.

## Setup

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(ggsci)

helper_dir <- if (dir.exists("../helpful_functions")) {
  "../helpful_functions"
} else {
  "helpful_functions"
}
source(file.path(helper_dir, "data_io.R"))
source(file.path(helper_dir, "analysis_functions.R"))

stopifnot(all(vapply(
  c("new_sub_data_long", "neg_control_threshold"),
  exists,
  logical(1)
)))
```

## Plot selected correlations

```{r plot-correlations}
features_to_plot <- c(
  "IgG1_RBD_WT",
  "FcgR2AR_S1",
  "IgG1_S1",
  "FcgR3B_RBD_gamma"
)

make_correlation_plot <- function(feature, group = NULL, subtitle, color) {
  plot_data <- new_sub_data_long[new_sub_data_long$features == feature, ]
  if (!is.null(group)) {
    plot_data <- plot_data[plot_data$vax_group == group, ]
  }

  ggplot(plot_data, aes(Vax1_days, vals)) +
    geom_point(shape = 21, fill = color, size = 4.5) +
    geom_hline(
      yintercept = unname(neg_control_threshold[feature]),
      linetype = "dashed",
      color = "red"
    ) +
    stat_cor(method = "spearman", label.y.npc = 0.1, color = color, size = 4) +
    labs(
      x = "Gestational age (days)",
      y = "log10 (MFI)",
      title = format_feature_label(feature),
      subtitle = subtitle
    ) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 18),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 15, hjust = 0.5)
    )
}

panel_colors <- c("#1F77B4", "#ff0a3f", "#f39333")
correlation_plots <- unlist(lapply(features_to_plot, function(feature) {
  list(
    make_correlation_plot(feature, NULL, "Entire third trimester", panel_colors[1]) +
      geom_vline(xintercept = 32 * 7, linetype = "dashed"),
    make_correlation_plot(feature, "<32_weeks", "28-32 weeks", panel_colors[2]),
    make_correlation_plot(feature, ">32_weeks", "32-36 weeks", panel_colors[3])
  )
}), recursive = FALSE)

figure_4bc <- ggarrange(plotlist = correlation_plots, ncol = 3, nrow = 4)
```

## Save Figure 4B-C panels

```{r save-figure}
ggsave(
  output_path("Figure_4", "Figure_4BC_timing_correlations.png"),
  figure_4bc,
  width = 12,
  height = 14,
  units = "in"
)
```
